Antz.name: Antz
Antz.summary: Antz is a side-scrolling platformer based on the movie of the same name. You take the role of Z, and you set out to win the heart of Princess Bala. Each of the 19 levels is based on situations in the movie. Your character has a variety of actions: crouching down, going through tunnels, hiding from enemies, jumping over obstacles, hanging from trees, climbing ropes and more. You also encounter boss characters.

Bomberman Selection.name: Bomberman Selection
Bomberman Selection.summary: Bomberman Selection was a Korean-exclusive Game Boy Color compilation cartridge.

Conker's Pocket Tales.name: Conker's Pocket Tales
Conker's Pocket Tales.summary: It's Conker's birthday and someone crashed his party! The Evil Acorn has stolen all of Conker's presents and kidnapped his best chipmunk friend, Berri. Now you must take on the role of the bushy-tailed hero, pursuing your nemesis throughout 6 visually-stunning worlds to rescue Berri and save your birthday from complete disaster. Strain your brain to solve challenging puzzles, battle the Evil Acorn's horde of minions with your trusty slingshot, and even flex your muscles in sporting events as you track your foe to the final showdown!

Grand Casino.name: Grand Casino
Grand Casino.summary: Grand Casino is a gambling game that was shown (alongside Altron's Billiard Club) at Spaceworld 2000 with a release planned for that October, only to be scrapped. It eventually surfaced as part of the September 2020 Game Boy lotcheck leaks.
